November 2025
I cannot express enough gratitude to Paul and his team at Hope House. They are truly dedicated to helping people overcome their addictions. When Daniel experienced a relapse, they didn’t judge him, they welcomed him back with open arms and unwavering support.

Daniel is now back in treatment, and this time he is genuinely learning to take responsibility for his actions, including addressing some of the challenging behaviours he struggled with previously.

Choosing Hope House in Thailand has been a game changer for Daniel’s recovery. It offers incredible value compared to the UK, three months of excellent care in Thailand costs only slightly more than one month in England. Being away from triggers and able to focus fully on his recovery has  brought my son back.

December 2023
What can I say but I've got my son back.   When my son went to Hope 6 months ago he was in a very bad place with Cocaine and Cannabis, being an active addict for around 15 years.  He has tried getting clean previously by going to meetings and previous rehabs but always came unstuck.   I have much more hope this time as Paul and the team have spent alot of time challenging my son's behaviour and working with him to overcome and address his issues.   I can't sing Paul and the team's praises enough, Paul has always been available for me to speak to him.  The dedication of the team for recovery addicts and alcoholics is amazing.  Brilliant, thank you.

Hope House literally saved my life. I arrived struggling with heavy alcohol dependence and anxiety. Over the course of three months, they guided me through initial detox and helped me build a foundation for recovery.

The daily AA activities, meditation sessions, and weekly onsite psychologist meetings were helpful in addressing both my drinking and anxiety. They also incorporated Smart Recovery techniques, which really complemented the program.

The staff were compassionate and professional. The monthly pricing was very reasonable (maybe a quarter of the price of other rehab centers in the area). The smaller size of operations really helped with my anxiety.

I initially planned to stay one month but ended up staying three. I highly recommend Hope House to anyone.

Had a wonderful experience at Hope House! Grateful for Paul taking me in and everyone else there for helping me come out feeling stronger.

Everyone there was so helpful and went out their way to make me feel welcome and comfortable for my 2 months stay there.

They had a pool, gym, sauna, ice bath, bikes, meditation room and a huge dining area where you can all hang out! The rooms were perfect and the bed was to die for! If you had any problems they’d fix it for you asap!

The sessions, classes and excursions were the perfect opportunity to help me get out of my shell. We had the Orphans come to visit and that really made me feel good to give back to the community.

I would definitely recommend Hope House to anyone who needs help because the people there were so friendly and welcoming.

Missing Hope House already and the team and of course Jerry and Sushi 🐈‍⬛

Jasmine

Perfect rehab for getting clean and ready to face the world as a sober person. I have nothing but good things to say about hope house and the team running it.

You will come out clean and with an amazing tools set to face the wider world as a sober person.

The facilities are amazing and the care offered is second to none. You will leave this place with a renewed sense of hope and full understanding of the 12 step process as swell as plenty of other techniques to manage your sober living.

I trust I will not have to come back as a client anymore after regaining my sanity back here, one things is for sure: I will forever be grateful for this place and the people I met here.

text: Amazing place with amazing staff! Helped change my life which I’m so Greatful for! Shout out to Paul and the sober house crew.
Top notch care from a top notch staff. Changes lives of addicts and their families. Much love and respect for Hope House
A wonderful place with wonderful people. Paul is a great guy and this place really can help to change your life. You really feel like family being there and I can't recommend it enough.

As someone who has been through numerous treatment centers and sober houses etc, I can honestly say Hope House is one of the best places. Other places have treated me poorly, kicked me out at night and left me homeless, and essentially robbed my family of their money. That doesn't happen at hope house. Paul is the only person who has let me come in without an immediate down payment. He is flexible when necessary and really cares about his clients, as well as the rest of the staff. When they say they will help you achieve a goal they actually follow through with it. For example they helped me become an english teacher. (which other places said they would do but actually didn't)
They have tons of activities to do there. Meditation, exercise, muay thai, step work, counseling, fishing, teaching english, and taking classes are some of the many many possibilities available. And theres plenty of relaxing too! It's a great place for those who already have some clean time but are weary of stepping back fully into the real world. Many good supportive friends can be made here as well which is an essential part of recovery. No program is perfect. But as someone who's had some awful experiences with other programs, I can definitely say hope was a great experience for me.

A safe and caring environment. It was my first experience living in a sober community and something I will forever cherish. Paul and his team go out of their way to ensure a stable and nurturing atmosphere. I learned a lot in the 5 months of living there and feel very grateful that such a place exists!

This is such an amazing place for second stage rehab.  Wonderful staff that become family and would go above and beyond for any client. The accommodations are clean and up to date. Free wifi and wonderfully prepared meals. The program that …

I made the best decision of my life when I decided to come to the Hope(sober)house. I was 2 and a half months in primary treatment but the journey had just begun, living clean, going to meetings, working the steps, in a safe environment and with caring and understanding people, that's what you do and learn. Paul is a person with a very big heart and I learned so much from him and still learning. I can't express my gratitude with words. I gained so much in my recovery so far I could never believe that would be possible, but it is and the best is yet to come!
Phil
